Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the driver was changing lanes. Complaints centered on neck
and low back pain with associated muscle tightness and reduced range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the
reported crash, and the presentation fits the expected pattern for this type of impact. Imaging and physical examination findings
clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. No prior injury to these body areas is known from the patient
history reviewed at intake. Care included 15 visits consisting of manual therapy, targeted home exercise instruction, and
as-needed analgesic management. Treatment followed a typical course, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and
function returned. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At the
most recent evaluation, the patient reported mild residual stiffness and was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions
to return if symptoms recur.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
